name: meet-recorder
description: Google Meet recorder for the meeting minutes bot: Cloudflare Worker, Durable Object and Playwright container

scripts.image:local: npm run build:bot && podman build -t meet-recorder:local .
scripts.meet:login: npm run image:local && mkdir -p auth && podman run --rm -it -p 127.0.0.1:6080:6080 -v "$PWD/auth:/out" meet-recorder:local login
